# roadmap.sh

> > Community-driven platform providing step-by-step learning roadmaps for developers across multiple programming languages, frameworks, and career paths.

roadmap.sh offers comprehensive visual guides for mastering technologies like JavaScript, Python, React, Node.js, and more, with AI tutor support and hands-on projects. The platform serves beginners and experienced developers looking to advance their careers in web development, backend engineering, database management, and other technical roles.

## Key Topics

- JavaScript
- Python
- Node.js
- React
- TypeScript
- HTML/CSS
- PostgreSQL
- Redis
- GitHub
- Go
- Rust
- Java
- PHP
- Backend Development
- Web Development

## Core Resources

- [Developer Roadmaps - roadmap.sh](https://roadmap.sh): Homepage: community-driven roadmaps for developers across multiple roles
- [Developer Roadmaps](https://roadmap.sh/roadmaps): Directory of all roadmaps: role-based, skill-based, and language paths
- [Developer Roadmaps](https://roadmap.sh/get-started): Getting started guide with AI tutor and beginner-friendly roadmaps
- [Guides - roadmap.sh](https://roadmap.sh/guides): Collection of tutorials, comparisons, and programming guides
